scope: Section116 UNSW width512, four methods, five formal seeds; resource sizing only
profile: Full prepared TRAIN/TEST, seed1, three hidden layers, CPU4 per process, original 8 epochs and minimum 2000 steps per stage
source_note: Same entry bytes in all four profiles; intervening commit changes only the work order. Formal entry adds reporting/mode/resume, not training changes.
walltime_formula: ceil_minutes(max(measured four method full-cell elapsed) * ceil(20/4) * 1.30)
memory_note: 32GiB is the owner-specified allocation ceiling, not observed usage. Observed local per-process RSS was approximately 0.60-0.72GB; no claim of 32GiB measured demand.
limitations: Local Windows CPU timing is a scheduling estimate, not a Genoa benchmark. Monitor actual allocated CPU utilization; preserve the project below10%-for-one-third-walltime guard. Profile results are not included in formal five-seed comparisons.
